title: Shared definitions
description: Shapes more than one schema uses, defined once. Registered with ajv by every caller that compiles a schema that refers here (validate_data.mjs and the specs that compile unit.schema.json alone).

unlock.description: Progression gate. roe_rating_min is the mechanism that makes restraint pay off.

stars_min.description: Opens when the campaign's earned stars (the sum of best-of stars over campaign.mission_results, spec 2026-09-10 §4.6) reach this. The three star-gated units carry 12, 30 and 44, fitted to the measured optimal ladder (docs/campaign/special_units/design.md §2).

price.description: Credits that open this unit from the brigade screen without its earned gates (spec 2026-09-15 §4.4). A unit whose unlock carries ONLY a price is bought-only. Never `bought`: that is resolved by the app from the brigade account and cannot be authored.
